item.title: California’s AI Laws Are About to Meet Reality
item.description:
Author: Lakera Team
Date: December 16, 2025
Tags: ["AI Regulation", "California Law", "Artificial Intelligence", "Healthcare Technology", "Consumer Protection"]
Summary:
  • California will enforce new AI laws starting January 1, 2026.
  • The laws focus on AI systems that interact directly with people.
  • AI chatbots must prevent self-harm content and intervene when users are at risk.
  • Healthcare and wellness AI face stricter regulations.
  • These laws mark a shift from theory to practical AI governance.

item.title: Phare LLM benchmark V2: Reasoning models don't guarantee better security
item.description:
Author: Alexandre Bouchard
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "AI Security", "Machine Learning", "Model Robustness", "Adversarial Attacks"]
Summary:
  • Reasoning models improve logical problem-solving in AI.
  • They do not inherently enhance security.
  • Security threats exploit weaknesses beyond reasoning.
  • Robust training and verification are crucial for AI safety.
  • Reasoning models can still be manipulated by adversaries.
  • A layered security approach is necessary for trustworthy AI.
